purpose: Test whether a frozen hybrid router improves report-level aviation maintenance triage over named approved baselines on 10,000 independent FAA SDR records.
unit_of_analysis: One unique FAA Service Difficulty Report identified by OperatorControlNumber.

development_window.use: Feature design, model fitting, fixed hyperparameter selection, and router training only.

holdout_window.selection: Sort eligible unique OperatorControlNumber values by SHA-256(protocol_id + ':' + OperatorControlNumber) and take the first 10000.

task.name: JASC chapter triage
task.target: First two characters of a valid four-character JASCCode; chapters with fewer than 200 base-model-fit rows map to OTHER.
forbidden_features: OperatorControlNumber except for deterministic split selection
task.reason_for_forbidden_features: They reveal or directly restate the maintenance outcome, create post-event leakage, or are identifiers rather than deployable predictors.

approved_baselines: aircraft-make frequency table with global fallback
one-vs-rest linear logistic regression trained by SGD
direct LightGBM when the pinned implementation is available
direct XGBoost when the pinned implementation is available
candidate: Frozen hybrid router trained only on development data to select among approved baseline-family predictions; no holdout-trained routing.

router.selection_metric: macro F1, then multiclass log loss, then stable model name
router.fallback: globally strongest approved baseline on the 2025 router-selection window

implementation.logistic: One-hot encoded SGD log-loss classifier, max_iter=200, early stopping enabled

primary_metric: macro F1 across mapped JASC chapters represented in the evaluated window
secondary_metrics: worst supported aircraft-make subgroup macro F1

statistics.method: paired stratified bootstrap over unique report IDs
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction across candidate-versus-baseline confirmatory comparisons

promotion_gate: Exactly 10000 unique holdout report IDs and zero development/holdout overlap.
All feature transforms fit on development data only.
Candidate primary-metric improvement over the strongest approved baseline has a multiplicity-adjusted 95% lower confidence bound greater than zero.
Candidate log loss is no worse than the strongest approved baseline by more than the preregistered noninferiority margin of 0.01.
No supported aircraft-make subgroup with at least 200 holdout rows loses more than 0.03 macro F1 versus the strongest approved baseline.
All predictions, failures, seeds, package versions, input hashes, and non-wins are preserved.

rolls_royce_subgroup.rule: EngineMake normalizes to RROYCE or ROLLS ROYCE, or EngineModel matches a declared Rolls-Royce family token.
rolls_royce_subgroup.reason: The current public holdout has too few Rolls-Royce-coded reports and no fleet exposure denominator.

claim_boundary: This is maintenance-report triage research. It is not an FAA or OEM evaluation, an airworthiness determination, an engine-health monitor, a failure-rate estimate, an operational decision aid, or evidence of a relationship with Rolls-Royce.
